sources.name: NSE - current and upcoming issues (JSON)
sources.note: Works with a browser User-Agent and Referer https://www.nseindia.com/. Fields: companyName, issueStartDate, issueEndDate, issuePrice, series (EQ = mainboard, SM/SME = SME), status (Active / Forthcoming). category=sme returned an empty object on 19-Oct-2026; SME issues may appear in this list with an SME series. Anchor allocation and RHP zips are on nsearchives.nseindia.com, which is denied by the network policy (19-Oct-2026); allow it to read the official anchor list.
